title: Project Manager
description:
Project Manager – Construction

Job Description

We are looking for an experienced Project Manager to oversee building construction projects, manage client relationships, and coordinate site operations from project initiation to final handover.

Key Responsibilities

Manage client communication, meetings, and project updates.

Plan and monitor project schedules, budgets, and milestones.

Coordinate with architects, structural engineers, site engineers, contractors, and suppliers.

Supervise daily site activities and ensure work meets quality and safety standards.

Monitor labour, materials, project costs, and resource allocation.

Handle client requirements, drawing revisions, additional work, and approvals.

Prepare progress reports and resolve project-related issues.

Monitor billing, payment schedules, and project expenses.

Ensure timely project completion and successful client handover.

Requirements

B.E. / B.Tech in Civil Engineering.

5–10 years of experience in building construction and project management.

Strong client communication and team management skills.

Knowledge of construction drawings, BOQ, estimation, billing, and project scheduling.

Ability to manage multiple activities and meet project deadlines.

Preferred Skills

Client relationship management

Site execution and quality control

Cost and budget management

Contractor and labour coordination

Project planning and reporting

Job Location: Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: From ₹25,000.00 per month

Work Location: Remote

title: Solar Project Manager
description:
We are expanding our rooftop solar operations across Tamil Nadu and need a practical, hands-on Project Leader based in Coimbatore. Your main job is to take confirmed orders (residential and commercial) and get them installed and commissioned without compromising on safety or quality.

You will be actively managing our field supervisors, keeping external installation vendors in line, tracking local inventory, and dealing directly with DISCOMs to get net-meters approved. Prior experience managing rooftop solar projects is mandatory.

**What You Will Actually Do Day-to-Day**:

* **End to End Project Execution**: Oversee the day-to-day deployment of multiple residential & commercial rooftop solar projects simultaneously across Tamil Nadu. Ensure all projects are completed on time, within budget, and to premium quality standards.
* **Team Leadership**: Manage, mentor, and deploy a distributed team of site surveyors, field engineers, and installation supervisors. Establish strict safety protocols, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and quality checkpoints.
* **Vendor & (I&C) Management**: Build, onboard, and manage a robust network of local Installation & Commissioning (I&C) teams and labor contractors. Negotiate rates, monitor daily progress, and audit their workmanship.
* **Procurement & Inventory**: Coordinate regional supply chain logistics. Manage structural, electrical, and component inventory (modules, inverters, structures, BoS) to ensure zero site-delivery delays while minimizing local warehousing overheads.
* **DISCOM Liaisoning & Subsidy paperwork**: Own the relationship with DISCOM officials to ensure seamless site inspections, structure approvals, and fast net-metering synchronization.

**What We Are Looking For:**

* **Education**: B.Tech / Diploma in Electrical, Civil, or Mechanical Engineering.
* **Experience**: 8 to 10+ years in solar project management, with at least 2+ years explicitly leading high-volume residential or commercial rooftop solar installations.
* **Regulatory Knowledge**: Deep familiarity with Tamil Nadu electrical safety regulations, DISCOM net-metering procedures, and national portal subsidy guidelines.
* **Leadership Style**: A hands-on operational leader who split time between tracking timelines via project management tools and doing high-audit site visits in the field.

**What’s in it for You:**

* A fixed salary matching market standards.
* Performance bonuses tied directly to project turnaround time and zero-defect quality audits.
* A direct line to the founders and the opportunity to scale our operational blueprint across the region.

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Health insurance
* Provident Fund

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Preferred)

Experience:

* solar project management: 8 years (Preferred)

Language:

* Tamil (Required)

Willingness to travel:

* 100% (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

title: Project Coordinator
description:
**Job Title: Project Co-Ordinator**  
**Company : Antsquad Branding Studio**  
**Job Location: Anna Silai, Coimbatore**

**About the Role** HighThink Media Box is looking for a highly organized, proactive, and ownership-driven Project Coordinator to lead and manage branding and creative projects from initiation to final delivery. This role is critical to our agency’s success, acting as the central bridge between clients, creative teams, and leadership. The Project Coordinator will ensure that every project is delivered on time, within scope, and aligned with brand strategy and quality standards.

This is a high-responsibility role and a key pillar in scaling HighThink Media Box operations. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced creative environment, understands branding workflows, and can manage multiple projects while maintaining clarity, structure, and accountability across teams.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Project Planning & Execution**

* Own and manage the end-to-end lifecycle of branding and creative projects.
* Define project scope, timelines, deliverables, and milestones.
* Break down projects into actionable tasks and assign them to relevant teams.
* Ensure all projects are delivered on time, within scope, and aligned with client expectations.

**Client Coordination & Communication**

* Act as the primary point of contact for clients during project execution.
* Understand client requirements, objectives, and brand expectations clearly.
* Provide regular updates, progress reports, and status communication.
* Handle client feedback professionally and translate it into actionable tasks.
* Build strong, long-term client relationships through clear communication and reliability.

**Team Collaboration & Workflow Management**

* Coordinate with Brand Designers, Video Editors, Content Writers, and Digital Marketers.
* Ensure smooth communication between internal teams and avoid bottlenecks.
* Conduct daily/weekly follow-ups to track progress and maintain accountability.
* Ensure all team members are aligned with project goals and deadlines.

**Timeline & Delivery Management**

* Create and maintain project timelines, trackers, and dashboards.
* Monitor progress and proactively address delays or risks.
* Ensure timely delivery without compromising quality.
* Manage multiple projects simultaneously with structured prioritization.

**Quality Control & Brand Alignment**

* Ensure all deliverables meet agency quality standards and brand guidelines.
* Review outputs before client submission to maintain consistency and excellence.
* Work closely with creative teams to ensure brand strategy is reflected in execution.

**Meeting & Documentation**

* Schedule and lead internal and client meetings.
* Document meeting notes, action items, and responsibilities.
* Ensure follow-ups are completed within deadlines.
* Maintain structured project documentation, reports, and archives.

**Risk Management & Problem Solving**

* Identify potential risks, delays, or resource gaps early.
* Take proactive steps to resolve issues and keep projects on track.
* Handle unexpected challenges calmly and provide solutions quickly.

**Process Improvement & Productivity**

* Identify gaps in workflows and suggest improvements.
* Implement tools and systems to improve team efficiency and project tracking.
* Contribute to building standard operating procedures (SOPs) for project management.

**Required Qualifications**

* 1–4 years of experience in Project Management, Client Servicing, or Operations/Coordination roles.
* Experience in a branding, advertising, digital marketing, or creative agency is highly preferred.
* Strong organizational and multitasking abilities.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects under tight deadlines.
* Strong problem-solving and decision-making mindset.
* High level of ownership and accountability.

**Technical & Tool Skills**

* Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint).
* Basic understanding of branding processes, creative workflows, and digital marketing deliverables.

**Preferred Traits**

* Understands branding, creativity, and client expectations.
* Can bring structure to a fast-moving creative environment.
* Is highly proactive and solution-oriented.
* Takes complete ownership of projects from start to finish.
* Has strong follow-up discipline and attention to detail.
* Can confidently interact with both clients and internal teams.
* Is adaptable and thrives under pressure.
* Focuses on driving execution leadership that directly impacts client satisfaction, delivery timelines, team productivity, and agency growth.

**Work Location:** In person

**How to Apply**

Send your resume to: **hr@highthink.in**  
Or contact HR Manager at: **90922 50922**

Pay: ₹20,000.00 - ₹30,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Project Management Intern
description:
Project Management Intern

Location: No.23, Ansari St, Ram Nagar, Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu 641009

Mode: On-site | 5 Days Working | Immediate Joiner Only

Stipend: Up to ₹10,000/month with performance based incentives

Policy: BYOD (Bring Your Own Device)

Duration: 6 Months

About the Company

Backdropsource.in is a global e-commerce brand redefining creative display

and visual storytelling. Since 2004, we have been serving photographers,

businesses, and event professionals with high-quality, customizable

backdrops and display solutions.

With a strong international presence across the US, UK, Canada, and Australia, we

continue to innovate and scale globally.

About the Role

The intern will help plan, track and deliver projects across our design, production, sales and customer support teams. You will work closely with the project lead to keep timelines on track, follow up on pending tasks and keep everyone informed.

This role suits someone organized and proactive who wants hands-on exposure to how projects and orders move through a global e-commerce business.

Key Responsibilities

* Track projects and orders from requirement to design, production and dispatch, flagging delays early.
* Maintain project trackers, timelines and task lists in Excel, Google Sheets or project management tools.
* Coordinate with the design, production, sales and customer support teams to keep deliverables on schedule.
* Follow up with team members on pending tasks, approvals and deadlines.
* Prepare daily and weekly status reports for the project lead and management.
* Schedule meetings, record minutes of meetings (MOMs) and track action items to closure.
* Maintain project documentation, checklists and standard operating procedures (SOPs).
* Identify recurring bottlenecks and suggest improvements to workflows.
* Support other operational and project-related tasks as assigned.

Requirements

* Pursuing or recently completed a bachelor's or master's degree in any discipline (BBA, MBA, B.Com, B.E./B.Tech or similar).
* Working knowledge of MS Excel or Google Sheets, plus MS Word or Google Docs.
* Basic understanding of e-commerce, printing or production workflows.
* Familiarity with project management tools such as Trello, Asana, ClickUp, Jira or Monday.com.
* Basic understanding of e-commerce, printing or production workflows.

What you’ll Gain

* Internship certificate on successful completion of 6 months.
* Hands-on project coordination experience in a global e-commerce brand.
* Mentorship from the project lead and exposure to design, production and sales operations.
* Possibility of a full-time role based on performance and business needs

Pay: ₹8,000.00 - ₹10,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Project Coordinator & QA
description:

**Location:** Ramanathapuram, Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu

**Work Mode:** Office

**Salary:** ₹23000 to 30000

JOB SUMMARY

* Good knowledge of bug tracking and issue management
* Strong communication and coordination skills
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities
* Strong attention to detail and organizational skills
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities

**Software Testing, Manual Testing, QA, Project Coordination, IT Projects, Web Applications, UAT, Bug Tracking, or Software Development.**
